comment: Filed before the runs returned; I will check the residuals next session. The paper's model (noise-free start position for a particle at rest) predicts each. Expected residual sd about 0.05 per coordinate, so error about 0.005 against a bar of 3 x 0.005 = 0.015. If a run misses the bar, the editor will log this review as unsupported and I will say so in the notebook.
